name: contrastapi
description: 54 keyless security tools: CVE/KEV, threat intel, DNS/SSL, email posture, Sigma, MITRE.
long_description: ContrastAPI gives Claude 54 security tools with no signup and no API key: vulnerability intelligence (CVE lookup/search, KEV, exploits, CVSS, CWE), threat intelligence (IOC/hash/IP/domain reputation, phishing, threat reports), infrastructure recon (DNS, WHOIS, SSL, subdomains, tech fingerprinting, security headers), email security posture (SPF/DMARC/MX, disposable detection), MITRE ATT&CK/ATLAS/D3FEND mappings, Sigma detection rules, and website scanning. Free tier works out of the box (keyless, rate-limited per IP); an optional Pro key raises limits. This extension is a thin stdio bridge to the hosted API at api.contrastcyber.com — no data is stored locally.
